resources.text: Synthetic recording transcript. 0:00–0:20: BFS explores an unweighted graph with a queue. 0:20–1:00: When a vertex at distance d is removed, undiscovered neighbors get distance d+1. FIFO preserves the layer order, so first discovery gives minimum edge count. Mark at enqueue time. A–B–C has distances0,1,2. Equal edge costs are essential; this is not a guarantee of minimum arbitrary weighted cost. Synthetic source board at0:37.5 shows the path. End at1:00.
